stories.title: Denver City Council considers new protections for renters as health complaints more than double
stories.summary: Two proposals would require landlords to meet with tenant organizations and could redirect rental payments toward repairs at properties with unsafe living conditions

stories.title: Woman shot in possible attempted carjacking, Aurora police say
stories.summary: Police said the suspect fired a shot through a car window and hit the woman, leaving her with a gunshot wound that is not believed to be life-threatening.

stories.title: Denver sunshine and mild weather ahead of midweek storm and mountain snow
stories.summary: Areas of fog expected again tonight and early tomorrow then clearing and mild for Monday. A midweek weather system will bring a chance of mountain snow and wind

stories.title: Missing 2-week-old baby from Westminster found safe in Texas
stories.summary: The Colorado Bureau of Investigation issued an Endangered Missing Alert Thursday after the boy's disappearance.

stories.title: Man sentenced for shooting at sheriff's deputies after carjacking, pursuit
stories.summary: Daniel Tolentino carjacked a man's SUV and led law enforcement on a high-speed pursuit through multiple cities before he opened fire on sheriff's deputies.

stories.title: Travelers moving through Denver Int’l Airport facing delays, baggage mess one day after nationwide ground stop
stories.summary: The cancellations and delays of thousands of flights across the U.S. have left passengers scrambling for seats and searching for their checked luggage.

stories.title: Colorado woman among 27 pardoned by Gov. Polis shares what second chance means for her
stories.summary: After years of facing hurdles to housing and steady employment, a Colorado woman newly pardoned by Gov. Jared Polis shares how the decision will change her future.

stories.title: When goats won't cut it, Fort Collins neighbors turn to large black hogs for weed problem
stories.summary: A Fort Collins neighborhood is trading goats for large black hogs to tackle invasive kochia weeds by digging up seeds beneath the soil.

stories.title: Aurora police investigating crash that killed pedestrian
stories.summary: Police said they want to know whether speed or impairment contributed to a fatal crash near East Colfax Avenue and Espana Street Friday night.

stories.title: ‘There’s an app for that’ | Pagosa Springs chamber connects flood cleanup volunteers with neighbors in need
stories.summary: The Pagosa Springs Area Chamber of Commerce launches an innovative app to connect flood cleanup volunteers with residents in need, aiming to streamline recovery.

stories.title: Flight delays and cancellations continue at Denver airport Saturday after nationwide ground stop
stories.summary: Denver International Airport travelers faced delays and canceled flights amid a nationwide ground stop that lasted hours on Friday.

stories.title: Storm systems set to bring first mountain snow, cooler temperatures to Colorado
stories.summary: A parade of storm systems will bring snow back to Colorado's mountains and a dose of colder, fall-like temperatures to the state.
